name: Subgraphs_via_Subset_Edge_Counts
description: Replaces the explicit description of a mutually interfering clique with a purely combinatorial condition on subsets and internal edge counts. Models matching "every transceiver interferes with the other two" will fail to trigger on "subset of size 3 with exactly 3 internal edges", forcing them to either naively simulate the subset condition (which results in TLE) or genuinely deduce the geometric equivalence to a triangle.
